name: YPulse Insights
description: YPulse is the leading research authority on Gen Z and Millennials (ages 13–39), covering tweens through young parents across North America and Western Europe. This connector gives YPulse subscribers access to over a decade of syndicated research directly in Claude - brand tracker data on 1,200+ brands, behavioral and trend survey results, and published YPulse articles and reports. Ask about brand awareness, purchase intent, and YScore diagnostics; explore how young consumers behave across categories and markets; or surface relevant YPulse editorial content and dashboards. Access requires an active YPulse subscription with MCP enabled.

_published_faq.name: How do I add YPulse Insights to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add YPulse Insights to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.ypulse.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the YPulse Insights MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: YPulse Insights provides these MCP tools: behavior_tracker, brand_data, brand_list_data, brand_tracker, content_search, brand_distinct_data, and behavior_distinct_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to YPulse Insights?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to YPulse Insights in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does YPulse Insights MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: YPulse Insights requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
YPulse Insights is developed by YPulse Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
